candidates.title: [ux-sim] Confusing UI on / — “I'm in”
candidates.body:
> **AI simulation — hypotheses, not measured user behaviour.** Found by AI personas driving a real browser — a hypothesis to confirm, not measured behaviour.

### Problem

Confusing UI on `/` around “I'm in”. Seen by **5 simulated persona(s)** across 4 scenario(s); severity max **3** (Major — real confusion, a wrong path or many extra steps; I nearly gave up or only got through by guessing.), median 2.

### Evidence

- **aisha-firstgen-anxious** · `find-a-club` · run `baseline-aisha-find-a-club` step 0 · sev 2 — “Wait, the first thing I see is a big photo of a stranger named Maya and an 'I'm in' button. I came to find a club… is this a dating thing? I don't want to accidentally tap 'I'm in' and sign up for coffee with someone I don't know.” [screenshot](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/baseline-aisha-find-a-club/shots/000-start.jpg) · [marked](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/baseline-aisha-find-a-club/shots/000-start-som.jpg)
- **diego-transfer-commuter** · `lunch-today` · run `baseline-diego-lunch-today` step 0 · sev 2 — “OK, a big face photo first thing. Coffee tomorrow at 6 isn't lunch today. Is this a dating thing or a plans thing? I just want lunch people.” [screenshot](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/baseline-diego-lunch-today/shots/000-start.jpg) · [marked](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/baseline-diego-lunch-today/shots/000-start-som.jpg)
- **priya-phd-desktop** · `internship-near-berkeley` · run `baseline-priya-internship-near-berkeley` step 0 · sev 2 — “I'm on a 1440px laptop and I get a phone-width column with a giant face photo and an 'I'm in' button. Is this a dating app? I came for internships.” [screenshot](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/baseline-priya-internship-near-berkeley/shots/000-start.jpg) · [marked](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/baseline-priya-internship-near-berkeley/shots/000-start-som.jpg)
- **seoyeon-exchange-korean** · `ride-sfo-thanksgiving` · run `baseline-seoyeon-ride-sfo-thanksgiving` step 0 · sev 2 — “어... 큰 얼굴 사진? 데이트 앱인가? 공항 가는 차 찾으려고 왔는데 커피 약속이 나와요. 영어만 있고... 한국어 설정 어디 있지?” [screenshot](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/baseline-seoyeon-ride-sfo-thanksgiving/shots/000-start.jpg) · [marked](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/baseline-seoyeon-ride-sfo-thanksgiving/shots/000-start-som.jpg)
- **minji-freshman-17** · `lunch-today` · run `smoke-minji-lunch-today` step 0 · sev 3 — “헐 big face photo… is this a dating app? And 'I'm in' — in what, coffee with Maya or matching with her?” [screenshot](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/smoke-minji-lunch-today/shots/000-start.jpg) · [marked](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/smoke-minji-lunch-today/shots/000-start-som.jpg)

Runs: [`baseline-aisha-find-a-club`](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/baseline-aisha-find-a-club/report.md), [`baseline-diego-lunch-today`](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/baseline-diego-lunch-today/report.md), [`baseline-priya-internship-near-berkeley`](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/baseline-priya-internship-near-berkeley/report.md), [`baseline-seoyeon-ride-sfo-thanksgiving`](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/baseline-seoyeon-ride-sfo-thanksgiving/report.md), [`smoke-minji-lunch-today`](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/smoke-minji-lunch-today/report.md)

### Personas affected

`aisha-firstgen-anxious`, `diego-transfer-commuter`, `priya-phd-desktop`, `seoyeon-exchange-korean`, `minji-freshman-17`

### Suggestion (hypothesis)

Make it obvious what “I'm in” on / does before people tap it — plain-word label, visible result, or a one-line hint. Personas said they wanted: “Tell me what this home screen is for, and that 'I'm in' joins a coffee meetup, not something public”; “show me what's happening today, not one person's face”; “A desktop layout and a home screen that tells me what this app is for, not a swipe card”; “첫 화면에 '무엇을 찾나요?' 같은 선택이나 라이드 쉐어 바로가기”; “say what I'm joining, like 'Join coffee'”.

### Note

Found by AI personas driving a real browser. Treat it as a hypothesis to confirm with real students, not as measured behaviour; counts are numbers of simulated personas, not user rates.
